attributes.body:
Spark Perceptions debuts Aurora at MJBizCon 2025.

The automatic precision combustion device (not a vape!).

Spark Perceptions, a Massachusetts-based technology startup specializing in automatic precision combustion systems, today announced the debut of its flagship device, Aurora, at MJBizCon 2025 in Las Vegas. After months of R&D and engineering refinement, Aurora has completed its engineering validation and is now preparing for mass production.

Next-Generation precision combustion technology.

Designed for users who value pure combustion, material efficiency, and effortless handling, Aurora represents the next generation of precision combustion technology - now featuring automatic control that delivers consistent performance with every use. The product embodies Spark Perceptions' mission to merge scientific precision with practical usability.

Inside Aurora: intelligent design and engineering.

A newly released teardown diagram reveals Aurora's internal architecture, highlighting its optimized airflow pathways, advanced heat regulation, and waste-minimizing material design. Every component has been engineered to deliver measurable improvements in purity, control, and energy efficiency.

"Our mission has always been to bring precision engineering to a category often overlooked by serious innovation," said Roger Gong, CEO of Spark Perceptions. "Aurora proves that combustion can be intelligent, efficient, and aesthetically refined. It's not a vape - it's a new standard."

Connecting innovation with industry at MJBizCon 2025.

By launching Aurora at MJBizCon, Spark Perceptions aims to connect with distributors, retail buyers, and technology reviewers who share its vision of elevating combustion technology through design-driven engineering and performance excellence.

About Spark Perceptions.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Massachusetts, Spark Perceptions develops next-generation combustion systems that combine precision engineering with user-centered design. Through its flagship product Aurora, the company reimagines combustion technology for modern lifestyles - from creative expression and outdoor exploration to social gatherings and everyday convenience.

Visit Spark Perceptions at Booth #C26308 during MJBizCon 2025, or learn more at www.sparkperceptions.com.
